product_one_liner.value: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is an AI-driven financial-crime risk intelligence platform that helps financial institutions and other regulated businesses screen and monitor customers and transactions to detect financial crime.
product_one_liner.notes: Company homepage and Mesh product page describe the product and its use.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists plan tiers and prices, including a Starter plan from $99/month.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified as customers in customer stories/case study pages.

employee_band.notes: Reported headcounts conflict across sources and extend beyond the requested bands: LinkedIn indexed at more than 500, while other estimates range around 76 to 507. Could not establish a reliable band.

hq_location.notes: The company LinkedIn page and company press announcement identify London as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company LinkedIn profile states it was founded in 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The technology blog index includes multiple engineering-authored posts on Elasticsearch zero-downtime strategy, LLM extraction pipelines, and AI agents.

public_docs.notes: Public API reference includes several substantive sections, including authentication, endpoints, entities, case management, and webhooks.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page is live but does not expose job titles in the available page extraction; searches did not confirm a current AI/ML/data-science-titled opening.

model_provider.notes: Public company materials examined describe AI use but do not identify a specific model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The product page explicitly lists SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification and describes GDPR alignment.

last_funding.notes: Company announcement dates the $50 million Series C to July 2020. Search results mention an extension, but no later dated round was confirmed from an accessible primary announcement.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent verifiable round located was announced in July 2020, outside the 18-month period before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company's LinkedIn jobs listing shows Business Development Representative and Account Executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Payment Screening on Mesh was announced May 19, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No reliably verifiable C-level/VP join or departure during the period was found; the company team roster was not available for a complete check.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Company materials and readable job/docs sources did not establish a CRM or sales/marketing system visibly used by ComplyAdvantage.
